headline: Godcrofts and Dead Lands Flare as Coastal Battles Shift
war_summary: Godcrofts has erupted into renewed island fighting over the past two hours, recording five base exchanges centered around Lipsia and leaving one position ruined in neutral hands. The deadlock in the Dead Lands has also broken with three swift strategic transfers at The Salt March alongside accelerating casualty tallies exceeding two thousand combatants in two hours. Farranac Coast maintains steady pressure with three further base transitions across Mara, Scythe, and Terra during the same interval. In contrast, strategic turnover has paused along Fishermans Row, Tempest Island, and Stlican Shelf after earlier flurries, though Stlican Shelf continues to suffer heavy casualties. Meanwhile, relentless frontline attrition persists without territory shifting hands across Weathered Expanse, Linn of Mercy, King's Cage, and Lykos Isle, where combined casualties remain among the war's highest.
